description: Bridge chart of the top 400's total tax rate, United States, 2018-20: Balkir et al. (2025) put it at 23.8%, below everyone's 30.2%; Splinter's three adjustments (+3 for excluding 'pure' capital gains, +8 for splitting family fortunes across tax returns, +3 for under-reported state and local taxes) take it to 38%, above everyone's 25% when transfers count as income.

transform.calculate: datum.step == 1 ? {'title': 'Everyone, Balkir et al. (2025)', 'Total tax rate': '30.2%'} : datum.step == 2 ? {'title': 'Top 400, Balkir et al. (2025)', 'Total tax rate': '23.8%'} : datum.step == 3 ? {'title': 'Excluding “pure” capital gains', 'Adds to the top 400’s rate': '3 points'} : datum.step == 4 ? {'title': 'Family fortunes split across several tax returns', 'Adds to the top 400’s rate': '8 points'} : datum.step == 5 ? {'title': 'Under-reported state and local taxes', 'Adds to the top 400’s rate': '3 points'} : datum.step == 6 ? {'title': 'Top 400, Splinter (2025)', 'Total tax rate': '38%'} : {'title': 'Everyone, Splinter (2025)', 'Total tax rate': '25%', 'Note': 'counts transfers as income'}
